user.title: Household Assistant
user.description: Assist will be able to ask the Household Assistant app. In the app, an admin turns on App settings → Answer Assist; then choose Household Assistant as the conversation agent of a voice assistant (Settings → Voice assistants).

abort.already_configured: The Household Assistant is already set up.

data_description.voice_user: A voice satellite doesn't say who is speaking. Its questions are asked as this person, with their access in each app, or not at all.
data_description.timeout: A model on the Home Assistant machine's CPU can take several minutes; the answer is also on the app's page.
